content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stripe alternatives

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are platforms. They rent you access to payment processing, product hosting, and delivery mechanisms. In exchange, they control the terms of your business. Sovereign commerce infrastructure is different. It's a combination of tools you own: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments handles crypto payments with a 0.5% fee. The customer owns the entire stack after deployment. No platform dependency. No subscriptions. Lifetime access.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms exclude countries based on regulatory, financial, or risk assessments. Stripe's 46-country limit isn't expanding fast enough for creators in Nigeria, Pakistan, or Zimbabwe. PayPal can suspend accounts for 180 days with no appeal, freezing your funds. Sovereign infrastructure doesn't exclude countries because it's not a platform. It's a combination of open tools and protocols. GitHub, Cloudflare, and Supabase don't care where you're from. NOWPayments processes crypto payments from anywhere with no KYC. The architecture itself is the alternative — not a workaround, but a permanent base layer.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Platforms charge 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction (or more) and deposit funds on their schedule. NOWPayments charges 0.5% and fires a webhook the moment payment confirms on-chain. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. The real cost of platforms isn't the fee — it's the risk of account suspension, fund holds, or sudden policy changes. Sovereign infrastructure has no platform fees, no fund holds, and no single point of failure. The customer owns the payment logic, the hosting, and the delivery mechanisms.
Platforms exclude countries. Infrastructure doesn't.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Platforms own your customer data, payment logic, and product hosting. If they shut down or change terms, you lose access. Sovereign infrastructure gives you full data ownership. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver files. The entire stack is automated and deployed under your control. COREMERCH configures and hands off the infrastructure — then has no access. The customer owns the GitHub repo, the Cloudflare account, and the Supabase database. No platform dependency. No subscriptions. Lifetime access.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you're selling digital products in a country excluded by Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad, sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only structural alternative. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) deploys GitHub Pages + Apps Script + NOWPayments in 48 hours. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments, with SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured and end-to-end tested. Choose based on your technical comfort and scale needs. Both options give you full ownership, automatic crypto payment processing, and instant product delivery. The infrastructure is pressure-tested against actual payment rejection, currency collapse, and financial isolation. It's not a workaround — it's a base layer.

Combine GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Use NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing with a 0.5% fee. This architecture gives you full ownership, no platform dependency, and lifetime access. It's not a workaround — it's a permanent base layer.

Your Deployment Checklist

Deploy your sovereign commerce stack with these steps: 1. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 2. Set up backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 3. Configure order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets. 4. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. 5. Integrate NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing. 6. Load your products and test end-to-end. 7. Deploy and own your infrastructure. No platform dependency. No subscriptions. Lifetime access.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I accept payments from any country with sovereign commerce infrastructure?
Yes. NOWPayments processes crypto payments from anywhere with no KYC. The architecture itself is borderless — not tied to any platform or country-specific regulation.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments is a payment processor, not a platform. If it fails, swap in another crypto payment gateway. The backend logic in Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script remains under your control.
Do I need technical skills to deploy this infrastructure?

Basic technical skills are helpful, but COREMERCH deploys and configures the stack for you. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) include 30-day support and full documentation.
Can I scale this infrastructure as my business grows?
Yes. Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments are designed for scalability. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates for advanced configurations.
What if I want to switch payment processors later?
The payment logic is in your backend code. Swap in any crypto payment gateway that supports webhooks. The infrastructure is modular — you own every component.
